cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Let Go of the Grudge
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender resentment, distance, or a claim that keeps the relationship stuck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Come sit beside me at dinner. I know you're still angry I missed your opening night.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You left that seat empty. You can have an empty one tonight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I deserved that last night. Could tonight's seat have you in it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm still going to tell you what you missed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please do. Move your plate over; I want to hear every scene.

mechanism: A copies an apparent reconciliation gesture without understanding its practical cause and uses the correction to seek an end to distance.
confusable: D84 asks release of grudge; D75 only acknowledgment of hurt would not suffice.
comparison: Dinner after missed opening versus helping move after missed birthday.
seedUse: Keep B willingness to recount performance as active repair.
